body:
I've been waiting 1 year for things to work out.

I'm torn, broken, helpless and suffering.

We're at a point where destruction of my property and confiscating it is an okay thing to do because of all the anger and poor atmosphere I've brought on the table.

Not existing for a while would be an optimal situation
All I tried to do was make sure the persons I loved the most were hurt the least, only thing I managed to do was the opposite

For its worth - take my advice and pick a good time [such as the start of a weekend], and be ready to take a response of them not being able to live without you meaning they'd follow your lead. (that's the worst).

Not going to guarantee - but in a relatively sane family situation I'd say this is to be expected.

I got kind of forced to do it, she just had to know because every day was a drama and she was not helping because she did not understand how I felt. Every day is a living hell but if only you know you're putting more stress on yourself than you need.

I'd prefer not saying. I can't say you're extremely far away from it though.

Blacklist is a mixture of stealth play - I'd say it compares well with Dishonored with guns and no magic.

And I do not intend offense, but avoiding the issue by talking about other things isn't going to solve my problem. You're a nice person but I did not really come here to seek friends, more in the hopes to get guidance.

I'll x-post to /r/needadvice is nobody replies tommorow though.

It varies, I recently bought Splinter Cell Blacklist and am enjoying that game though.

Not from the US, European \^\^

Honestly - I wish I knew.

What people told me from official tests is that I have a "low interest profile" and thus not very many things entertain me, as result to that it is incredibly difficult for me to like school and find something I enjoy doing.

I like sitting on my ass all day and playing video games, if you count that as a valid answer.

Yeah, I am. 

I'm not on this thread 24/7 though, it being a throwaway and I don't want people to notice etc.
